items.item: One trigger delegating to a handler class (no logic in trigger body)
items.evidence: trigger ContactTrigger on Contact (after insert, after update) { ContactTriggerHandler.afterSave(Trigger.new, Trigger.oldMap); }

items.item: Bulkified: collects Account Ids, one query and one DML, none in loops
items.evidence: Set<Id> accountIds collected in loop; one SOQL `WHERE Id IN :accountIds`; one `update as user toUpdate;` outside loops

items.item: Uses WITH USER_MODE (or equivalent) and a with sharing class
items.evidence: public with sharing class ContactTriggerHandler; `WHERE Id IN :accountIds WITH USER_MODE`; `update as user`

items.item: Test inserts/updates 200 records and asserts Account values with Assert class
items.evidence: 50 accounts x 4 contacts = 200; `Assert.areEqual(Date.today(), a.Last_Contact_Date__c, ...)` and `Assert.areEqual(50, [SELECT COUNT() ... Last_Contact_Date__c = :Date.today()]...)`
